title: Hayati Pro Max Fresh Menthol Mojito Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Hayati Pro Max Fresh Menthol Mojito combines cool Mint with a tangy squeeze of Lime and a brisk Menthol finish for a bright, refreshing vape. The Mint is clean and cooling, the Lime brings a sweet, citrus sharpness, and the Menthol amplifies the chill—capturing the essence of a classic mojito-style flavour with vivid clarity. Crafted with nicotine salts for faster absorption and a smoother inhale, this e-liquid is ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping using pod kits and starter devices. The 50VG/50PG blend provides dependable flavour and discreet vapour throughout the day. This flavour is part of the Hayati Pro Max Nic Salt range, inspired by Hayati’s own bestselling disposable vapes and now reimagined in a longer-lasting 10ml format—available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths.
